footprint.scope: Static cloned CALL spans only; distances unweighted by execution frequency. No causal performance claim.

findings: All 1,474 cloned CALL records are bound by PCMAP to original CALL SIR. Actual native CALL emission has 216 BL instructions in both variants; zero no-BL to BL changes and zero lost tail-B sites.
All 532 cloned functions retain original frame size, callee-save count and leaf class; 390 shared-fuel leaf2 functions remain leaf2.
416 cloned CALL spans change instruction length; their aggregate difference is minus 2,730 words. Static helper-fusion loss and frame inflation are not supported by these comparisons.

Full image grows from 87,716 to 152,292 bytes because original bodies are preserved plus 532 private clones; original539 becomes1071functions. Direct-branch distance aggregate rises from1,484,952 to1,553,152 bytes over611 static CALL spans. Neither count is dynamically weighted or a proven slowdown cause.
limitations: Static counts do not establish executed hotness, cache-miss rates or causality.
EMIT spans account for skip/coalescing as emitted; zero-BL spans alone do not distinguish every fusion family. Preserved skip and branch classifications support the narrow negative check.
Reader-cache modes are not printed by this observer; do not claim independently sampled runtime cache-mode frequencies.
Independent V4 whole-machine proof separately binds cloned SIR, fix targets, aux1 entries and permitted guard deletions. This diagnosis does not rerun native proof, timing or profiling.
